about: Canada's regional 'Avoid all travel' blocks the stay spots were checked against (Global Affairs Canada's feed of 2026-10-15, then its live feed on 2026-10-18): per country, each block by its heading, a fingerprint of its words, and the places inside it that never become stay anchors. Under 'us', the same for the US State Department's regional 'Do not travel' areas where it names them (its RSS feed of 2026-10-18): per country below level 4, a fingerprint of the feed's 'Do Not Travel to' words and the places inside an area they name. Where the feed says some areas have increased risk but names none (Mexico, India), the whole row is fingerprinted and its 'note' records the review by hand against travel.state.gov. A skipped place may carry its point ('ll') and other names ('aka'); a candidate within 5 km of that point, or under one of those names, is skipped too. scripts/gen_stay_spots.py --check flags a block or a US list that is new, gone or reworded.

BR.note: The public line names Brazil's land borders with no exception. The feed's only Foz exception is in the staff rules ("Within 100 miles/160 km of Brazil’s land borders (except travel to the Foz do Iguacu and Pantanal)"), which govern US government employees, not the public advice, so it exempts nothing here. Canada's 20 km Paraguay band is avoid non-essential, where a chip may stay; the US line takes the falls out. Rio, Salvador and Manaus are hundreds of km from any land border.

CI.note: The feed's row names no area. Search-engine copies of travel.state.gov's advisory read on 2026-10-18 give Do Not Travel to the northern border region with Mali and Burkina Faso (one copy: within 50 km). The chips are far south of it: Assinie, Abidjan, Yamoussoukro, Man; the gallery's Kong and Comoé National Park only top up a list under four and are not reached.

IN.note: The feed's row names no area. MX.note: The feed's row names no area ("Check the maps of restricted areas"). travel.state.gov refuses scripted reads (403, bot check); search-engine copies of its advisory read on 2026-10-18 give Do Not Travel to Colima, Guerrero, Michoacán, Sinaloa, Tamaulipas and Zacatecas. No chip or candidate is in them: Cancún and Tulum (Quintana Roo), Chichen Itza (Yucatán), Mexico City, Oaxaca; the gallery's Xochimilco, Teotihuacan and Cabo San Lucas are not reached (five things-to-do places fill the list).
